svg.title: dsh-soe-decision-check structure: a three-segment procedure trace band
svg.desc: Register and rule pack feed runTableCheck(); one matter is drawn as a trace band split into pre-study, meeting review and resolution record; SD-001 hits the empty proposal and basis, SD-003 compares the two dates across the segment boundary, SD-006 is skipped; issues[] and skipped[] leave the band and the verdict stays with the reviewer.
